purpose: Provide source-verified fixed purpose and currency reference reads through the existing purchase lookup API, with strict binding/schema qualification and typed exact source values.
constraints: Use only directly verified source bindings AP_PurposeRequestListFrm header PurposeID at308051 and CurrencyID at308060; sanitize evidence to metadata/addresses/query hashes, no raw owner SQL or rows.

Fixed feature SQL only; never execute arbitrary SQL from configuration. Validate exact live binding tuple, uniqueness/aliases, schema/types and required NULL distinctions. Drift, malformed shape, extra result sets or inadequate visibility stay unavailable.

Purpose source AP_PurposePurchaseTbl has nullable PurposeName and does not filter isDisable. Currency source CF_CurrencyTbl provides CurrencyID/displayID, CurrencyName order and float RateExchange. Do not invent defaults, positive-rate rules, disabled filtering or date-effective rates.

Preserve existing native read authorization, request/session/branch scope fences and cleanup ownership. Parameterized bounded search/paging, deterministic ordering, duplicate/alias rejection and no silent truncation. Zero DML/allocator/reservation.

Coordinate typed currency rate and nullable purpose labels with strict client parsing. Preserve existing branch lookup behavior/JSON where possible; document any additive shape. Lookup availability does not unlock editors, Create, Add, writes or monetary recalculation.
No new API/BFF routes, generic config interpreter, SQL/schema changes, private configuration, DLL/DB execution, allocator or UI changes. Existing unavailable kinds remain honest.

Actual production module tests plus endpoint and client regressions required, including NULL/rate fidelity, source/config/schema drift, aliases, late revocation, cancellation/cleanup and zero-write. Root alone publishes; independent review and exact-head/current-base CI precede merge.
